items.headline: Budget 2027 passes Second Reading by 97 votes
items.summary: Parliament approved the 2027 Budget at Second Reading, 157 votes to 60. The Committee Stage debate starts tomorrow, and the final Third Reading vote is set for 6 PM on 14 December.

items.headline: SC ruling on Organised Crime Bill reaches Speaker
items.summary: The Supreme Court's determination on the Prevention of Organised Crime Bill, which 26 parties including the BASL had challenged, has gone to the Speaker. It will be announced in Parliament, and its contents have not been made public yet.

items.headline: CBSL tightens vehicle valuation rules for leasing
items.summary: New Central Bank rules say how banks and finance companies must value vehicles for loans and leases, to stop lenders getting around loan-to-value limits. Registered vehicles now need a professional valuer.

items.headline: Maskeliya students update: five still in hospital
items.summary: 36 students at a Maskeliya school were admitted with breathing difficulties after breakfast. Thirty have been discharged and five remain in hospital, and the cause has not yet been confirmed.

items.headline: Fitch upgrades six Sri Lankan insurers
items.summary: Fitch raised the national ratings of six insurers by one notch after the sovereign rating upgrade. SLIC Life and SLIC General now hold the top AA-(lka) rating.

items.headline: UNP unveils new logo and Gen Z drive
items.summary: Ranil Wickremesinghe's UNP launched a new logo and new membership categories for Gen Z and millennial supporters.

items.headline: Minister says NPP concluded IMF programme professionally
items.summary: Minister Bimal Rathnayake told Parliament that this government is the only one to complete an IMF programme properly, and disputed opposition warnings.

items.headline: Colombo Port nears 2025 record a month early
items.summary: Transshipment rose 10% year-on-year in October. The port needs about 773,000 more TEUs to pass its 2025 total and could do it in November.

items.headline: SriLankan Airlines could break even this year
items.summary: The Deputy Aviation Minister said the airline may break even by the end of 2026. Ministry figures show a Rs. 8.9 billion loss in the first five months.

items.headline: Ex-tax officer jailed in 15-year-old bribery case
items.summary: A former Inland Revenue assessor was convicted of taking a Rs. 375,000 bribe in 2011 and must serve an effective four years in prison.

items.headline: Borella junction closed overnight from 10 PM
items.summary: The D.S. Senanayake junction in Borella is closed temporarily from 10 PM for repairs after a sewer leak caused the road to collapse.

items.headline: Afternoon thundershowers forecast for coming days
items.summary: The Met Department expects afternoon thundershowers mainly in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, North Western, Central and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara. Most areas should expect misty early mornings.

items.headline: Sri Lanka to end 2026 without a Test win
items.summary: Pakistan won the Rawalpindi Test by eight wickets, so Sri Lanka will have no Test win in a calendar year for the first time since 1997. The team has now gone eight series in a row without a win.

items.headline: UN rights chief urges Imran Khan's release
items.summary: The UN human rights chief called for the former Pakistani PM to be freed immediately. Earlier today, Sri Lanka's Parliament rejected a motion on the same issue.

items.headline: Poland says Russian missile struck its territory
items.summary: Poland said at least one Russian missile hit its southeast during an overnight attack on Ukraine. Investigators are checking three impact sites, and no injuries were reported.
